findings.title: Value ends with a newline from a YAML block scalar
findings.cause: container web exits because its args item "/etc/app/app.conf\n" ends with a newline, which a YAML literal block (|) keeps, so the program gets "/etc/app/app.conf\n" with the line break in it; its log says: "cat: can't open '/etc/app/app.conf"; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container web's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
cat: can't open '/etc/app/app.conf
': No such file or directory

evidence.what: container web's args ends with a newline: "/etc/app/app.conf\n"

findings.fix: Write "/etc/app/app.conf" on one line in quotes, or use |- or >- so YAML drops the final newline.
